intro: I’m Anand Grandhi. I work across product strategy, learning systems and AI-enabled business operations.
Previously at Amazon Academy and BYJU’S, I worked on products and operating systems at scale. Today, through ARCHMATION Studios, I focus on turning complex business problems into practical solutions.

projects.title: Turning declining engagement into a daily learning habit
projects.problem: Daily Digest engagement was declining despite an extensive content library.
projects.approach: Identified engagement bottlenecks, proposed personalised micro-sessions and defined the product behaviour with design and engineering.
projects.outcome: Reported daily active users rose from 35,000 to over 80,000 following the revamp.

projects.title: Reducing a six-hour content workflow to under an hour
projects.problem: Research, writing and publishing required repetitive manual coordination.
projects.approach: Designed an AI-assisted content pipeline with structured inputs and review checkpoints.
projects.outcome: Reported production time fell to 45 minutes per article.

projects.title: Making interactive STEM learning scalable
projects.problem: Interactive learning experiences required coordination across multiple specialist teams.
projects.approach: Worked across pedagogy, design, development and production to deliver reusable interactive experiences.
projects.outcome: The initiative delivered hundreds of applets and more than 150 games.

projects.title: Reducing editorial bottlenecks without compromising quality
Turning fragmented learning content into structured knowledge
projects.problem: Content was difficult to personalise without a shared model of concepts and prerequisites.
projects.approach: Defined learning objectives, relationships and content tagging across curricula.
projects.outcome: Enabled structured content discovery and learning pathway design.

projects.title: Making historical counselling knowledge useful in daily decisions
projects.problem: Counselling knowledge is dispersed across records, documents and conversations.
projects.approach: Explored transcript intelligence, structured workbooks and personalised planning with human review.
projects.outcome: Reference prototype; deployment outcomes are not claimed.
